sentences.zh: 你认为我们刚才谈到的这三个大领域中，哪一个在民调中显示最为重要，并因此可能对拜登的拖累最大？

sentences.en: Which of these three broad areas that we have just talked about do you think the poll shows to be the most important and potentially, therefore, is dragging Biden down the most?
sentences.zh: 老实说，

sentences.en: To be entirely honest,
sentences.zh: 我认为真的很难说这三个问题中哪一个最重要，很大程度上是因为几乎所有对拜登不满的选民都认同所有这些观点。

sentences.en: I think it is really hard to tell which of these three issues is most important in no small part because almost all of the voters who are hurting Biden believe all of these things.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: So how do you really tell which is most important if everyone believes it?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果每个人都认为它最重要，你到底该如何判断哪一个才是最重要的呢？

sentences.en: One thing I can say is the share of voters who say the economy is most important has gone up a lot over the last year in the same states where we did our Senate polling last fall.
sentences.zh: 有一点我可以肯定，在去年秋天我们进行参议院民调的那些州里，认为经济问题最重要的选民比例在过去一年中大幅上升了。

sentences.en: So compared to last fall, voters care more about the economy, a serious weakness for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 所以与去年秋天相比，选民们更关心经济问题，这对乔·拜登来说是一个严重的弱点。

sentences.en: So all in all, what we're looking at here, just to summarize the ground we've covered, is pretty broad disapproval of President Biden, both on a personal and a policy level.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我们在这里所看到的，简单总结一下我们讨论过的内容，就是选民对拜登总统在个人层面和政策层面上都表现出了相当广泛的不满。

sentences.en: And Trump's support neither really rising nor falling, but kind of just hovering in the same place it was the last time he ran for president.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普的支持率既没有真正上升也没有下降，只是徘徊在他上次竞选总统时的水平。

sentences.en: And all of that shakes out into a pretty meaningful advantage for Trump, disadvantage for Biden in these swing states.
sentences.zh: 所有这些因素综合起来，在这些摇摆州中，特朗普拥有相当明显的优势，而拜登则处于劣势。

sentences.en: In these swing states right now with a long ways to go.
sentences.zh: 在这些摇摆州，目前距离大选还有很长一段路要走。

sentences.en: Okay, we'll return to the long ways to go in just a little bit.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们稍后再回到“还有很长一段路要走”这个话题。

sentences.en: Now, you said all this is an across-the-board problem for Biden, but I wonder where you're seeing it most acutely, in which group or groups of voters.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说这对拜登来说是一个全面的问题，但我很好奇你是在哪些选民群体中观察到这种问题最为严重？

sentences.en: You're absolutely right that these problems that Joe Biden faces are very broad, and yet they have manifested very narrowly among just a few demographic groups.
sentences.zh: 你说得完全正确，乔·拜登面临的这些问题确实非常广泛，但它们在少数几个特定的人口群体中表现得尤为突出。

sentences.en: Which ones?
sentences.zh: 是哪些群体？

sentences.en: Young voters, black voters, and Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 年轻选民、黑人选民和拉丁裔选民。

sentences.en: What exactly are we seeing among these three categories of voters?
sentences.zh: 在这三类选民中，我们具体看到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, we're seeing levels of support for Donald Trump that would have been unimaginable just a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们看到他们对唐纳德·特朗普的支持率达到了几年前无法想象的程度。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: You know, in 2020, Joe Biden won young voters by more than 20 points.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在2020年，乔·拜登在年轻选民中的得票率领先了20多个百分点。

sentences.en: Now the race is essentially tied among young voters in the polling.
sentences.zh: 而现在，民调显示他在年轻选民中的支持率基本与特朗普持平。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Biden won more than 90% of black voters in 2020.
sentences.zh: 拜登在2020年赢得了超过90%的黑人选民支持。

sentences.en: It was a huge part of his victory.
sentences.zh: 这是他获胜的关键部分。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And now he's around 70%.
sentences.zh: 而现在他的支持率大约只有70%。

sentences.en: And not only are those voters sort of undecided, Donald Trump is currently polling around 20% of black voters in these polls.
sentences.zh: 不仅这些选民处于某种摇摆状态，而且在这些民调中，唐纳德·特朗普目前获得了约20%的黑人选民支持。

sentences.en: So this poll finds that black voters are not just kind of fleeing Biden.
sentences.zh: 所以这项民调发现，黑人选民不仅仅是在疏远拜登。

sentences.en: They are running directly to Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们正在直接转向特朗普。

sentences.en: They're willing to tell the pollster Trump, which is not something that I've seen before.
sentences.zh: 他们愿意向民调人员表达对特朗普的支持，这在以前是我从未见过的。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: And then among Latino voters, there's a similar decline there as well.
sentences.zh: 而在拉丁裔选民中，也有类似的下降趋势。

sentences.en: Biden won more than 60% of the Hispanic vote in these states in 2020.
sentences.zh: 拜登在2020年这些州的拉美裔选票中赢得了超过60%的支持。

sentences.en: And now he's barely winning it all.
sentences.zh: 而现在他几乎难以保住这一优势。

sentences.en: Barely winning it all with Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 在拉丁裔选民中几乎难以保住优势。

sentences.en: Single-digit lead.
sentences.zh: 领先优势仅为个位数。

sentences.en: And potentially, according to this poll, in these states could lose the Latino vote.
sentences.zh: 根据这项民调，他甚至有可能在这些州失去拉丁裔选票。

sentences.en: Not out of the question.
sentences.zh: 这并非不可能。

sentences.en: But he does lead the Latino vote in these states, to be clear.
sentences.zh: 但需要明确的是，他目前在这些州的拉丁裔选票中确实仍处于领先地位。

sentences.en: Those do feel like potentially historic swings among a longtime foundation of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 对于民主党长期以来的支持基础而言，这看起来确实像是具有历史意义的转变。

sentences.en: Young voters, black voters, Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 年轻选民、黑人选民、拉丁裔选民。

sentences.en: And we've talked about this trend a little bit, especially among black and Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 我们之前也讨论过这种趋势，特别是在黑人和拉丁裔选民中。

sentences.en: But my sense, my recollection from talking to you, is that this has been a kind of a slow kind of creeping problem from the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 但根据我与你的交谈，我的印象是，这对民主党来说一直是一种缓慢的、潜移默化的困扰。

sentences.en: What you're describing here feels much more potentially seismic.
sentences.zh: 而你现在所描述的情况，感觉更具潜在的震荡性。

sentences.en: Yeah, it feels like, you know, over the last decade or so that we've seen these signs of softness and weakness for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 是的，感觉就像在过去十年左右的时间里，我们已经看到了民主党支持率疲软的迹象。

sentences.en: And this is really the first time that it feels like you see something like a break in the polling.
sentences.zh: 而这确实是第一次让人感觉到民调数据出现了某种断裂。

sentences.en: Now, it's not an election result yet, and there's a long time.
sentences.zh: 当然，这还不是最终的选举结果，距离大选还有很长一段时间。

sentences.en: But if these polling results were right, it would represent a pretty fundamental change in American electoral politics.
sentences.zh: 但如果这些民调结果是准确的，那将代表美国选举政治发生了根本性的变化。

sentences.en: Nate, does the poll get at why this might be the case?
sentences.zh: 内特，民调有没有分析为什么会出现这种情况？

sentences.en: Why this shift might seem so seismic in this poll?
sentences.zh: 为什么这种转变在这项民调中看起来如此剧烈？

sentences.en: There have been all kinds of theories.
sentences.zh: 各种理论都有。

sentences.en: We've talked about them on the show about why this shift has been happening kind of on a slow basis.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中讨论过这种转变为何一直在缓慢发生。

sentences.en: But because it's happening on such a potentially big one right now, I wonder what the poll tells us about the why.
sentences.zh: 但因为它现在正以如此巨大的潜在规模发生，我很好奇民调告诉了我们关于“为什么”的什么信息。

sentences.en: So it's a really hard question, you know, as I mentioned, because all of these voters believe all of these various negative things about Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常难回答的问题，正如我提到的，因为这些选民对乔·拜登持有各种负面看法。

sentences.en: It's very hard to tell which of these things is really the one thing that matters more than anything else,
sentences.zh: 很难判断到底哪一个因素才是最重要的，

sentences.en: if it's even true that one of those things matters more than anything else.
sentences.zh: 甚至很难说是否真的存在一个最重要的因素。

sentences.en: What I do think the poll suggests is that the problems are more about Joe Biden and the economy than about the Democrats in general or ideology.
sentences.zh: 但我认为民调显示，这些问题更多是关于乔·拜登本人和经济问题，而不是关于民主党整体或意识形态。

sentences.en: One set of questions that we ask that really shapes my thinking on this is that we didn't only ask voters whether they prefer Joe Biden to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们问过的一系列问题确实塑造了我的思考，我们不仅询问选民是否更喜欢乔·拜登而不是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: We also asked whether they would prefer a hypothetical unnamed Democrat to Donald Trump if Joe Biden didn't run.
sentences.zh: 我们还询问了如果乔·拜登不参选，他们是否会更倾向于支持一位假设的、未具名的民主党人，而不是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And we also asked how they would vote in a hypothetical matchup between Kamala Harris, the vice president, and Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们还询问了如果副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯与唐纳德·特朗普进行假设性对决，他们会如何投票。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: And both the generic Democrat and Kamala Harris fare better than Joe Biden overall.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，无论是那位泛指的民主党人还是卡玛拉·哈里斯，表现都比乔·拜登要好。

sentences.en: That's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: And they in particular fare better than Joe Biden among the sort of young black and Hispanic voters that we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 特别是在我们刚才谈到的年轻黑人和拉美裔选民中，他们的表现比乔·拜登更好。

sentences.en: And in fact, this is kind of crazy, but if Joe Biden merely won over voters who support Kamala Harris over Donald Trump, but that who do not currently support Joe Biden,
sentences.zh: 事实上，这听起来有点疯狂，但如果乔·拜登仅仅是赢得了那些支持卡玛拉·哈里斯胜过唐纳德·特朗普，但目前不支持乔·拜登的选民，

sentences.en: all of Joe Biden's problems among young black and Latino voters go away.
sentences.zh: 那么乔·拜登在年轻黑人和拉丁裔选民中的所有问题就都迎刃而解了。

sentences.en: What that really seems to say is that this is a Joe Biden problem, especially among these groups of voters we just talked about.
sentences.zh: 这似乎真正说明了这是一个乔·拜登个人的问题，尤其是在我们刚才谈到的这些选民群体中。

sentences.en: And this would seem to add fuel to the pretty widespread complaint among some Democrats that there should have been a real primary this year,
sentences.zh: 这似乎会为一些民主党人中相当普遍的抱怨火上浇油，即今年本应该进行一场真正的初选，

sentences.en: that it should not have just been a coronation of Joe Biden, that there should have been an open primary,
sentences.zh: 不应该只是乔·拜登的加冕仪式，本应该有一场公开的初选，

sentences.en: the calendar shouldn't have been changed to benefit Joe Biden as it was by the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 民主党不应该为了让乔·拜登受益而修改选举日程。

sentences.en: That just saying Joe Biden again, given the issues we're talking about here, didn't necessarily seem like such a good idea.
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们在这里讨论的问题，仅仅再次推举乔·拜登似乎并不一定是个好主意。

sentences.en: This is absolutely going to add fuel to those Democratic concerns about whether Joe Biden is the right candidate to be the party's nominee next year.
sentences.zh: 这绝对会加剧民主党内部的担忧，即乔·拜登是否是明年作为该党候选人的合适人选。

sentences.en: It doesn't show that he can't win.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着他无法获胜。

sentences.en: He still has very real paths to win, paths that for many Democrats could be pretty straightforward.
sentences.zh: 他仍然有非常现实的获胜途径，对于许多民主党人来说，这些途径可能相当直接。

sentences.en: But I do think the poll shows that it'll be more challenging for Joe Biden to win this election than it probably ought to be, given that he's an incumbent,
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为民调显示，考虑到他是现任总统，

sentences.en: given how unpopular his opponent is, and given that he beat the same person last time.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他的对手是多么不受欢迎，以及他上次击败过同一个人，乔·拜登赢得这次选举将比他本应面对的更加困难。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你听到的那些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Nate, you just suggested that this poll reveals some real challenges for President Biden heading into the 2024 election, but that there are also real paths for victory.
sentences.zh: 内特，你刚才提到这项民调揭示了拜登总统在迈向2024年大选时面临的一些真正挑战，但也存在真正的获胜途径。

sentences.en: We're going to discuss both of those.
sentences.zh: 我们将讨论这两个方面。

sentences.en: I want to start with how state by state, since this is a poll of six battleground states, what we have just learned could translate into a loss for Biden against Trump.
sentences.zh: 我想先从各州的情况开始，因为这是一项针对六个摇摆州的民调，我们刚刚了解到的情况如何转化为拜登对阵特朗普的失利。

sentences.en: So just explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: Well, as we've mentioned, the poll shows Biden with this weakness among young Black and Hispanic voters.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我们提到的，民调显示拜登在年轻黑人和拉美裔选民中存在这种弱点。

sentences.en: And as a consequence, the results by state follow a very predictable and straightforward pattern where Joe Biden suffers the largest losses in relatively diverse and young states.
sentences.zh: 因此，各州的结果遵循了一个非常可预测且直接的模式，即乔·拜登在相对多元化和年轻的州遭受了最大的损失。

sentences.en: Nevada and Georgia, two states where nearly half of the electorate will be non-white, are states where Joe Biden is badly underperforming.
sentences.zh: 内华达州和佐治亚州，这两个州近一半的选民将是非白人，而乔·拜登在这些州的表现非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And he won those two states last time, and they were essential to his Electoral College victory.
sentences.zh: 他上次赢得了这两个州，它们对他赢得选举人团胜利至关重要。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's hurting him enough for him to be trailing in less diverse states like Pennsylvania and Michigan, which are predominantly white,
sentences.zh: 这对他造成了足够的伤害，以至于他在宾夕法尼亚州和密歇根州等以白人为主的州也处于落后状态，

sentences.en: but where Democrats still absolutely depend on support in places like Philadelphia and Detroit.
sentences.zh: 但在这些州，民主党仍然绝对依赖费城和底特律等地的支持。

sentences.en: Which have large populations of Black and Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 这些地方拥有大量的黑人和拉丁裔选民。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And right now he trails in those states because he's faring so poorly among those core Democratic constituencies.
sentences.zh: 目前他在这些州落后，因为他在这些民主党核心选民群体中的表现太差了。

sentences.en: So if you're the Biden campaign, you look at this and you say, if I can re-energize my support among young Black and Latino voters,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是拜登竞选团队，你看到这一点会说，如果我能重新激发年轻黑人和拉丁裔选民的支持，

sentences.en: I'm going to rapidly make gains in these sunbelt states.
sentences.zh: 我就能迅速在这些阳光地带的州取得进展。

sentences.en: And hopefully I can get myself just over the top in these more traditional battleground states like Michigan and Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 希望我能在密歇根州和宾夕法尼亚州这些更传统的摇摆州中以微弱优势胜出。

sentences.en: And how would, if you were the Biden campaign, and I imagine they're having this very conversation, would you do that?
sentences.zh: 如果你是拜登竞选团队，而且我想他们正在进行这样的对话，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: Oddly enough, I think recent re-election campaigns offer a pretty good playbook here.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我认为最近的连任竞选提供了一个很好的策略手册。

sentences.en: You know, in both 2004 and 2012, Barack Obama and George W.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在2004年和2012年，巴拉克·奥巴马和乔治·W·布什

sentences.en: Bush stared down the prospect that their bases weren't going to be sufficiently mobilized.
sentences.zh: 都曾面对他们的基本盘可能无法被充分动员的前景。

sentences.en: And so they ran a polarizing campaign on the issues that define their party to try and re-energize people who ought to have been their core supporters and bring them home.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们围绕定义其政党的议题开展了一场两极分化的竞选，试图重新激发那些本应是他们核心支持者的人，并让他们回归。

sentences.en: For example, what George W.
sentences.zh: 例如，乔治·W·布什在2004年所做的是，

sentences.en: Bush did in 2004 was he campaigned on gay marriage and gun rights to try and re-mobilize and re-energize his support among evangelical and rural conservative voters.
sentences.zh: 他以同性婚姻和枪支权利为竞选议题，试图重新动员和激发他在福音派和农村保守派选民中的支持。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember it well.
sentences.zh: 我记得很清楚。

sentences.en: Bush literally worked to put bans on gay marriage on the ballot in as many states as he could, knowing that would bring out Christian conservative voters.
sentences.zh: 布什确实努力在尽可能多的州将同性婚姻禁令列入选票，因为他知道这会吸引基督教保守派选民出来投票。

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And gay marriage got banned in those states as well.
sentences.zh: 而且同性婚姻在这些州也被禁止了。

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And Democrats, you can imagine doing something very similar in this election on an issue like abortion.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象民主党人在这次选举中也会在堕胎等议题上采取非常类似的策略。

sentences.en: In fact, in some ways, this is the playbook that Democrats used in the midterms last year.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在某种程度上，这就是民主党人在去年中期选举中使用的策略。

sentences.en: Now,
sentences.zh: 现在，

sentences.en: I should say I'm not 100 percent convinced that a rerun of the Democratic midterm playbook will yield the same result that Democrats got in the midterm last year in these states.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我并不百分之百确信重演民主党的中期选举策略会在这些州取得与去年中期选举相同的结果。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: This is a less ideological group of voters that we're talking about now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在谈论的是一群意识形态色彩较淡的选民。

sentences.en: We're almost by definition talking about people who did not vote in the midterm last year.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎可以肯定地说，这些人去年没有参加中期选举。

sentences.en: The sort of black and Latino voter who was motivated by democracy and abortion last fall is someone who's still supporting Biden in our polling today.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天被民主和堕胎议题激励的黑人和拉美裔选民，在今天的民调中仍然支持拜登。

sentences.en: The kind of voter who has left Joe Biden is the sort of person who wasn't motivated by these issues to turn out and vote last fall.
sentences.zh: 而那些已经离开乔·拜登的选民，是去年秋天并没有被这些议题激励去投票的人。

sentences.en: Now, you can imagine two interpretations here.
sentences.zh: 现在，你可以对这里的情况有两种解读。

sentences.en: One is that these people would never pay attention to a midterm, but if they heard the same thing, they would be energized by it, in which case maybe the same playbook on a higher,
sentences.zh: 一种是这些人从不关注中期选举，但如果他们听到了同样的信息，他们会被激励，在这种情况下，也许在他们关注的竞选中，通过更高、

sentences.en: louder, with more media attention in a race they know about will succeed in doing the same thing.
sentences.zh: 更响亮、媒体关注度更高的宣传，同样的策略会成功实现同样的效果。

sentences.en: Or alternately, they did hear the message they weren't motivated by it, they care about the economy, and that particular one's not going to work.
sentences.zh: 或者另一种可能是，他们确实听到了信息，但并没有被激励，他们关心的是经济，所以那个特定的策略不会奏效。

sentences.en: So both of those things are possible, but definitely things like this are in the playbook.
sentences.zh: 所以这两种情况都有可能，但这些确实都在策略手册中。

sentences.en: What are the things that Joe Biden can talk about that young black and Latino voters like that you don't believe will alienate your more solid support of white moderate voters?
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登可以谈论哪些年轻黑人和拉丁裔选民喜欢，但你认为又不会疏远他更稳固的白人温和派支持者的议题？

sentences.en: That's a challenging question for Biden to figure out.
sentences.zh: 这对拜登来说是一个具有挑战性的问题。

sentences.en: It is a challenging question, but it's also not the worst problem that you could have.
sentences.zh: 这是一个具有挑战性的问题，但这也不是你能遇到的最糟糕的问题。

sentences.en: We're talking about trying to win back traditional Democratic voters, including voters who are still open to voting for someone like Kamala Harris or our unnamed generic Democrat.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是试图赢回传统的民主党选民，包括那些仍然愿意投票给卡玛拉·哈里斯或我们那位未具名的泛指民主党人的选民。

sentences.en: This shouldn't be that hard to do.
sentences.zh: 这不应该那么难做到。

sentences.en: But in the scenario where Biden can't find that issue to bring these voters back to him in the Democratic Party, does he lose?
sentences.zh: 但在拜登找不到那个能把这些选民带回民主党的议题的情况下，他会输吗？

sentences.en: Not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不一定。

sentences.en: I think he still would have one narrow but clear path to win the three predominantly white Midwestern battleground states, Pennsylvania, Michigan, and Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我认为他仍然有一条狭窄但清晰的途径，可以赢得宾夕法尼亚州、密歇根州和威斯康星州这三个以白人为主的中西部摇摆州。

sentences.en: Biden is relatively close in these states, and in fact, he holds a lead in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 拜登在这些州的支持率相对接近，事实上，他在威斯康星州还保持着领先。

sentences.en: And interestingly, among likely voters, he pulls into the lead in Michigan,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在可能投票的选民中，他在密歇根州也取得了领先，

sentences.en: which reflects that so many of the voters who are dissatisfied by Trump are voters on the periphery of politics who Trump can't necessarily count on,
sentences.zh: 这反映出许多对特朗普不满的选民是政治边缘的选民，特朗普不一定能指望他们，

sentences.en: even though he earns their support in our polling.
sentences.zh: 尽管他在我们的民调中赢得了他们的支持。

sentences.en: So if you're the Biden campaign and you just can't remobilize the same level of support that you had among young black Latino voters,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是拜登竞选团队，而你无法重新动员你在年轻黑人和拉丁裔选民中曾经拥有的同样水平的支持，

sentences.en: you can still hope to do just well enough among the older white voters who represent Joe Biden's strength to muscle out a narrow win in these states,
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以希望在代表乔·拜登优势的老年白人选民中表现得足够好，从而在这些州以微弱优势胜出，

sentences.en: especially since these are among the likeliest voters in the electorate.
sentences.zh: 尤其是因为这些人是选民中最有可能投票的群体。

sentences.en: And what does he have to do to make sure his appeal among those voters remains as strong as possible?
sentences.zh: 他必须做些什么来确保他在这些选民中的吸引力尽可能保持强劲？

sentences.en: This is the group where I think the abortion and democracy path that they ran in the midterm last year gets Biden the fartheSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是他们去年中期选举中使用的堕胎和民主议题能让拜登走得最远的群体。

sentences.en: Whether it actually gets him over the top or not, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 它是否真的能让他胜出，我不知道。

sentences.en: But I think that these kinds of voters are exactly the kinds of relatively moderate voters who flip to Joe Biden because they don't like Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这些选民正是那种因为不喜欢唐纳德·特朗普而转向乔·拜登的相对温和的选民。

sentences.en: And you just reinforce those reasons.
sentences.zh: 你只需要强化这些理由。

sentences.en: And I think that you have a very credible path to keep them that's been demonstrated in previous elections under a somewhat similar circumstance.
sentences.zh: 我认为你有一个非常可信的途径来留住他们，这在之前的选举中在某种相似的情况下已经得到了证明。

sentences.en: OK, let's turn to Trump and how he capitalizes on the advantages that he clearly has based on the pull of these six states.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们转向特朗普，看看他如何利用基于这六个州民调所拥有的明显优势。

sentences.en: Well, Donald Trump is ahead right now, so you can look at all the reasons you're leading today and try and reinforce them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，唐纳德·特朗普目前处于领先地位，所以你可以审视今天领先的所有原因，并试图强化它们。

sentences.en: And that strikes me as a pretty plausible path.
sentences.zh: 这在我看来是一个相当可行的途径。

sentences.en: You can imagine him trying to reinforce concerns about Joe Biden's age and his capacity to handle the job.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象他试图强化人们对乔·拜登年龄及其处理工作能力的担忧。

sentences.en: You dwell on how everything in the world and in the country is a disaster and how if I were president, none of this would have happened.
sentences.zh: 你反复强调世界上和国内的一切都是一场灾难，如果我是总统，这一切都不会发生。

sentences.en: You can try and reach out to black and Latino voters in a way that maybe you haven't in previous elections.
sentences.zh: 你可以尝试以一种在之前选举中可能没有过的方式去接触黑人和拉丁裔选民。

sentences.en: I'll note that – I don't know if you saw this, but do you remember how back in 2015 Donald Trump kicked out Univision from a press conference?
sentences.zh: 我要指出的是——我不知道你是否看到了，但你还记得2015年唐纳德·特朗普是如何将Univision电视台赶出新闻发布会的吗？

sentences.en: I think I do.
sentences.zh: 我想我记得。

sentences.en: He's going to interview with that same person next week.
sentences.zh: 他下周要接受那个人的采访。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Somebody in his campaign told them that would be a good idea.
sentences.zh: 他竞选团队里有人告诉他们那是个好主意。

sentences.en: I think someone told them that would be a good idea.
sentences.zh: 我想是有人告诉他们那是个好主意。

sentences.en: Because it has a huge Latino audience, obviously.
sentences.zh: 因为显然，这能吸引大量的拉丁裔受众。

sentences.en: Because it has a huge Latino audience, obviously.
sentences.zh: 因为显然，这能吸引大量的拉丁裔受众。

sentences.en: But also, this is now his path to victory in a way that wasn't true four years ago.
sentences.zh: 但同时，这在某种程度上成了他通往胜利的路径，而四年前并非如此。

sentences.en: So you have to make sure if you're in the Trump campaign that at the very least you don't offend voters in the way you did four years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在特朗普的竞选团队里，你必须确保至少不要像四年前那样冒犯选民。

sentences.en: One thing I wish we had in our poll, by the way, is some measure of when's the last time you were offended by Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我真希望我们的民调里能有一个衡量指标，比如你上一次被唐纳德·特朗普冒犯是什么时候？

sentences.en: Because back when Donald Trump was doing poorly among these groups, it was like there was a controversial or racist remark in the news every week, right?
sentences.zh: 因为在唐纳德·特朗普在这些群体中表现不佳的时候，新闻里几乎每周都有争议性或种族主义的言论，对吧？

sentences.en: And that hasn't been true for a while.
sentences.zh: 而这种情况已经有一段时间没出现了。

sentences.en: And I think that could be an important part of why he's able to make gains among these voting blocs when he hasn't done so in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这可能是一个重要的原因，解释了为什么他能在过去表现不佳的选民群体中取得进展。

sentences.en: You're raising an interesting possibility that's just occurring to me as you're saying this, Nate, which is that a Donald Trump who's a bunch less present in our world,
sentences.zh: 内特，你提出了一个有趣的可能性，你这么一说我才想到，那就是一个在我们的世界里存在感低得多的唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: which he is for a variety of reasons, some strategic, some because he spends a lot of his time in a courtroom these days on all these trials,
sentences.zh: 由于各种原因，有些是出于战略考虑，有些是因为他最近把大量时间花在法庭上处理那些官司，

sentences.en: is perhaps a stronger presidential candidate for a number of these groups.
sentences.zh: 对于许多群体来说，可能是一个更强大的总统候选人。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And I think that if you step even farther back,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，如果你退后一步看，

sentences.en: it could be the case that Donald Trump's political messaging and his populist brand of conservatism has had the potential to have very broad appeal to Latino and black voters the whole time and that he held himself back among these groups.
sentences.zh: 情况可能是这样的：唐纳德·特朗普的政治信息和他那种民粹主义的保守派品牌，一直都有潜力吸引广大的拉丁裔和黑人选民，只是他之前在这些群体中有所克制。

sentences.en: By being.
sentences.zh: 通过……

sentences.en: By intentionally alienating them.
sentences.zh: 通过刻意疏远他们。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: By occasionally insulting them frontally.
sentences.zh: 通过偶尔正面侮辱他们。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And it's funny if you think about these elections chronologically.
sentences.zh: 如果你按时间顺序思考这些选举，会很有趣。

sentences.en: In 2016, he was offensive to both black and Latino voters and did terribly among both.
sentences.zh: 2016年，他冒犯了黑人和拉丁裔选民，在这两个群体中的表现都非常糟糕。

sentences.en: In 2020, he still campaigned against immigration, but it was no longer the focus of that election.
sentences.zh: 2020年，他依然在竞选中反对移民，但这不再是选举的焦点。

sentences.en: Black Lives Matter, Defund the Police was.
sentences.zh: 焦点是“黑人的命也是命”和“削减警察经费”运动。

sentences.en: He does way better among Latino voters while still struggling among black voters.
sentences.zh: 他在拉丁裔选民中的表现好多了，尽管在黑人选民中仍然挣扎。

sentences.en: And now we have a political moment where I'm not sure either of these issues are at the core of the campaign in the news right now.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们所处的政治时刻，我不确定这两个议题是否还是目前新闻中竞选的核心。

sentences.en: And now Donald Trump's doing better among both.
sentences.zh: 现在唐纳德·特朗普在这两个群体中的表现都在好转。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: What you're really describing is a potential brand of Trump populism that is more inclusive, it's less insulting,
sentences.zh: 你真正描述的是一种潜在的特朗普民粹主义品牌，它更具包容性，更少侮辱性，

sentences.en: and it's a clear path to victory when combined with what could end up being kind of daily assaults on Biden's weaknesses, his age, voter perceptions of the economy,
sentences.zh: 而且当它结合了对拜登弱点（如年龄、选民对经济的看法）的日常攻击时，这便是一条清晰的胜利之路，

sentences.en: that could put together an unusually broad coalition in this moment.
sentences.zh: 这可能会在当下汇聚成一个异常广泛的联盟。

sentences.en: And one that would represent a real turning point in modern American political history.
sentences.zh: 这也将代表现代美国政治史上的一个真正转折点。

sentences.en: Just explain that, because the turning point in modern American history, that's a big phrase.
sentences.zh: 解释一下，因为“现代美国历史的转折点”这个说法分量很重。

sentences.en: Since the enactment of the Civil Rights Act, our politics have been defined by high levels of racial polarization.
sentences.zh: 自《民权法案》颁布以来，我们的政治一直由高度的种族极化所定义。

sentences.en: They have also usually been defined by a great degree of generational polarization.
sentences.zh: 它们通常也由高度的代际极化所定义。

sentences.en: And the kind of politics that Donald Trump appears to be promoting right now may represent not a complete elimination of that pattern,
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德·特朗普目前似乎正在推动的这种政治，可能代表的不是对那种模式的彻底消除，

sentences.en: but a fairly significant reduction in racial and generational polarization in a way that would clearly distinguish this election from all those we've had previously.
sentences.zh: 而是种族和代际极化的显著降低，这将使这次选举与我们之前经历的所有选举明显区分开来。

sentences.en: And because we're talking about young and non-white voters, voters that are going to represent growing shares of the electorate in the future,
sentences.zh: 而且因为我们谈论的是年轻和非白人选民，这些选民在未来将代表越来越大的选民比例，

sentences.en: I do think we would look back on it as representing a turning point because of the consequences it would have for subsequent contests.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为我们会回顾这次选举，并将其视为一个转折点，因为它会对随后的竞选产生影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The R word is rolling around in my head.
sentences.zh: “重组”这个词在我脑海里盘旋。

sentences.en: If Donald Trump does what this poll suggests he might be able to do, especially with young black and Latino voters, that could amount to a realignment between the parties.
sentences.zh: 如果唐纳德·特朗普做到了这份民调暗示他可能做到的事，特别是在年轻黑人和拉丁裔选民中，那可能意味着党派之间的重组。

sentences.en: It would represent a significant change in what the Democrats can think of as a reliable coalition,
sentences.zh: 这将代表民主党所认为的可靠联盟发生了重大变化，

sentences.en: and it would represent a huge victory for Republicans in their ability to have broadened their coalition.
sentences.zh: 也将代表共和党在扩大联盟能力方面取得巨大胜利。

sentences.en: I want to reemphasize the word would if this happened, and we just laid out why Biden has a credible way to reassemble a lot of these voters, right?
sentences.zh: 我想再次强调“如果”这个词，如果这真的发生了，而且我们刚才也分析了为什么拜登有可靠的方法重新召集这些选民，对吧？

sentences.en: But if these poll results were mirrored in the final election results, this would be a realigning election.
sentences.zh: 但如果这些民调结果在最终选举结果中得到体现，那这将是一场重组性的选举。

sentences.en: And here's the part where we have to say it is one year off and a ton can change, and realignment is a really big word in our politics,
sentences.zh: 这里我们必须说，距离选举还有一年，很多事情都可能改变，“重组”在我们政治中是一个非常大的词，

sentences.en: but it would be merited if the election were tomorrow, which it's not.
sentences.zh: 但如果明天就举行选举，那这个词就是恰当的，虽然明天并不举行。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 确实不举行。

sentences.en: I'm so glad you came back to that, but I just want to reinforce it one more time.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你回到这一点，但我只想再强调一次。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a dissatisfied, disaffected, disengaged electorate that doesn't like their choices.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个不满、失望、疏离的选民群体，他们不喜欢自己的选择。

sentences.en: These are the textbook conditions for political volatility.
sentences.zh: 这些是政治动荡的典型条件。

sentences.en: It's also the conditions for political upheaval, right?
sentences.zh: 这也是政治剧变的条件，对吧？

sentences.en: This is when realigning elections happen, but it's also the conditions where voters really could flock back to where they were.
sentences.zh: 这就是重组性选举发生的时候，但这也是选民确实可能回归他们原有立场的条件。

sentences.en: Depending on any number of things that happen between now and then.
sentences.zh: 这取决于从现在到那时发生的任何事情。

sentences.en: I look at these results and I see the potential for huge changes, whether that's from the last election result or from these polls to the next.
sentences.zh: 我看着这些结果，看到了巨大变化的潜力，无论是与上次选举结果相比，还是从这些民调到下一次民调之间。

sentences.en: Well, Nate, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，内特，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.zh: 即使在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的消息。

sentences.zh: 哈马斯官员称，以色列周日对加沙中部一个人口稠密的难民营进行了空袭，造成至少47人死亡，数十人受伤。

sentences.zh: 如果得到证实，这将是一周内以色列第二次袭击加沙难民营。

sentences.zh: 随着以色列军队向加沙城推进，他们为巴勒斯坦人提供了四个小时的窗口期，以便安全撤离该地区。

sentences.en: Israel said it offered a similar window on Saturday, but that Hamas exploited it to attack Israeli troops.
sentences.zh: 以色列称周六也提供了类似的窗口期，但哈马斯利用它袭击了以色列军队。

sentences.en: And in Washington, D.C., tens of thousands of people gathered for the largest pro-Palestinian protest in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿特区，数万人聚集在一起，举行了自战争开始以来美国规模最大的亲巴勒斯坦抗议活动。

sentences.en: since the war began.
sentences.zh: 抗议者要求战争停火，并结束美国对以色列的军事援助。

sentences.en: The protesters demanded a ceasefire in the war and the end to U.S.
sentences.zh: 人群中的大部分愤怒都指向了拜登政府，该政府在针对哈马斯的行动中对以色列表示了强烈支持。

sentences.en: military aid for Israel.
sentences.zh: 在一个演讲中，一位穆斯林民权组织领导人警告拜登，选民将根据他处理战争的方式来评判他。

sentences.en: Much of the crowd's anger was directed at the Biden administration, which has expressed strong support for Israel in its campaign against Hamas.
sentences.zh: 我们的信息是：不停火，就没选票，不停火。
